description: Focusing on safety and the continued support of the Commonwealth’s healthcare system, the House recently passed H4888, a broad bill centered around adapting to a post-COVID-19 landscape in the administration of healthcare. The bill’s main focus was the integration of telehealth services, which has become the go-to for most patients and doctors alike. The bill […]
